rows.label: HYPOTENUSE

rows.label: FLARE

rows.label: CROTCHET

rows.label: CROTCH

rows.label: ELLIPSOID
rows.clue: A surface whose plane sections are all ellipses or circles

rows.label: CORRUGATION

rows.label: PARABOLA

rows.label: DECAGON

rows.label: LOVE LINE
rows.clue: A crease on the palm

rows.label: CLEFT

rows.label: RECTANGLE
rows.clue: A parallelogram with four right angles

rows.label: DROOP

rows.label: CRESCENT
rows.clue: Any shape resembling the curved shape of the moon in its first or last quarters

rows.label: BELL SHAPE
rows.clue: The shape of a bell

rows.label: CREASE
rows.clue: An angular or rounded shape made by folding

rows.clue: (astronomy) the plane on which a body is orbiting

rows.label: OCTAGON
rows.clue: An eight-sided polygon

rows.label: MOGUL

rows.label: BOUND

rows.label: PRISM

rows.label: CIRCLE

rows.label: BOTTLENECK
rows.clue: A narrowing that reduces the flow through a channel

rows.label: STRAIGHT LINE
rows.clue: A line traced by a point traveling in a constant direction

rows.label: TRUNCATED CONE
rows.clue: A frustum formed from a cone

rows.label: TANGENT PLANE

rows.clue: An angle less than 90 degrees but more than 0 degrees

rows.label: SOLID ANGLE
rows.clue: An angle formed by three or more planes intersecting at a common point (the vertex)

rows.label: WAVE ANGLE
rows.clue: The angle of arrival (or departure) of a radio wave with respect to the axis of an antenna array

rows.label: OVOID
rows.clue: An egg-shaped object

rows.label: WASHOUT

rows.label: SCOTCH
